test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

S P _ _ _ P S T S _ _ _ S P S _

options.text: T S S P T S S
P S S P P S S
P S T S P T T
S T S P S T T

solution:
Given :- S P _ _ _ P S T S _ _ _ S P S _ 

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) T S S P T S S → S P **T**** S - S** P S T - S **P T S** - S P S **S**

2) P S S P P S S → S P **P S - S **P S T - S **P P S** - S P S **S**

3) P S T S P T T → S P **P S - T** P S T - S **S P T - **S P S **T**

4) S T S P S T T → S P **S T - S** P S T - S **P S T** - S P S **T**

 
• Here **'****SPST'** is repeated.
 
• Option (4) gives the pattern of :- S P **S T** - S P S T - S P S T - S P S T

Hence, the correct answer is** "S T S P S T T".**
